release.hint: What decides allow or deny - agents' rights, policies, the Tool Registry, gateways and their routes - and the keys are frozen into a release that administrators sign with their passkeys. Once a release is in force, a change that loosens anything takes effect only when the quorum has signed the next release; a change that tightens takes effect at once.

release.settings_hint: These take effect with the next signed release. The quorum is how many administrators must sign (2 or more: one stolen device or one rogue administrator cannot loosen anything); validity: after it, nothing is allowed until a new release is signed; offline time: how long an enforcement point keeps working without this server; egress proxy binaries: a sensor on a proxy host lets the proxy out only while it runs one of these (sha256sum provenza-proxy), with one of the configurations (sha256sum proxy.json). Enforce mode: this server's gateways execute nothing and a check by the agent only observes - every action goes through an egress proxy in enforce mode, signed by the agent (the proxy's agent mode signs for clients that cannot); switching it on takes effect at once, switching it off only with a signed release.
